_readme: Site settings and the verified business facts the build writes into <head> (JSON-LD). Only facts with a source go here; hours and kashrut stay out until the owner confirms them (plan Q10, Q13). origin: the site's address, null until the owner picks a domain (Q5); while it is null the build writes no canonical, og:url or sitemap, and robots.txt keeps search engines out.
